commit_message: Fix ADR0145 Claude provider MCP wiring
pr_title: Implement ADR0145 first-class external agent provider adapters
pr_body: Implements ADR 0145 on current main with first-class Claude Code and Codex AgentRuntime adapters plus the generic fallback. This correction fixes Claude MCP configuration construction to emit valid JSON, uses the documented server-level MCP allowlist instead of an unsupported glob, and strengthens regression coverage by parsing the generated MCP config and exercising valid structured provider JSON. AgentHost run/permission/workspace/validation/completion contracts remain authoritative and unchanged.
